description: This file generates a platform pie chart for test results in the TestLink project. It loads configuration, retrieves test metrics per platform, prepares data, and renders a pie chart using the pChart library. It also contains functions for initializing arguments and checking user rights.

classes.name: pData
classes.description: Class used to manage dataset for charting.

classes.name: pChart
classes.description: Class used to generate pie charts with given configuration and data.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to access test plan metrics.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes request arguments, setting up environment for remote or anonymous access as needed.
